seoTitle: Master of Flags — Free Flag Quiz App, No Ads
metaDescription: Learn every country flag with a no-ads, no-subscription quiz. Daily Challenge, streaks, and a 250-flag encyclopedia with capitals. Free forever — start today.
heroSubhead: A geography quiz that respects you: no ads, no subscription, no account. Play free forever, and if you want more, Pro is one purchase you own for life.
highlights: No ads. No subscription. No account.
Free forever, Pro is a one-time purchase

features.title: Quiz the whole world
features.body: Test yourself across Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas and the world. Every region stays free.

features.title: Daily Challenge
features.body: Ten flags, once a day, with shareable results. Come back tomorrow for a new set.

features.title: Streaks that forgive
features.body: Build a daily streak. Streak freezes mean one busy day won't erase your run.

features.title: Flag Encyclopedia
features.body: Browse roughly 250 flags and territories with capitals and country facts. Free to read, anytime.

features.title: Hard Mode and Review
features.body: Pro adds eight-flag rounds and a Review Mistakes drill that targets the exact flags you missed.

features.title: Progress you can see
features.body: XP, levels, per-region stats, plus Game Center leaderboards and achievements.

howItWorks.body: Choose a continent or the whole world and start guessing flags right away.
Take the ten-flag Daily Challenge, keep your streak alive, and share your score.
Track progress in the encyclopedia and, if you want, unlock Pro for harder rounds and review.

faq.q: Is Master of Flags really free?
faq.a: Yes. The quiz, Daily Challenge, streaks, leaderboards and the full encyclopedia are free, with no ads and no account. You can play forever without paying.

faq.q: What does Pro unlock and how much is it?
faq.a: Pro is a single $4.99 one-time purchase. It adds Hard Mode (eight-flag rounds), Review Mistakes, a full Statistics dashboard, and five streak freezes a month instead of one. No subscription, ever.

faq.q: Are there any ads or subscriptions?
faq.a: No. There are no banner ads, no video ads, and no recurring charges. The only optional payment is the one-time Pro unlock.

faq.q: Does Master of Flags work offline?
faq.a: Yes. The quiz and encyclopedia run on your device. You only need a connection for Game Center leaderboards and achievements.
Your data stays on your device. Nothing is collected and nothing is tracked.

faq.q: I bought the app years ago when it was paid. Do I have to pay again?
faq.a: No. Early buyers are grandfathered into Pro automatically, free, forever. Tap Restore Purchases to bring it back on any new device.
iPhone and iPad running iOS or iPadOS 17.4 or later.

faq.q: How many flags can I learn?
faq.a: Roughly 250 flags and territories, each with its capital and country details in the encyclopedia.

iphone: Guess the flag, pick a region
ipad: Flag quiz on the bigger screen

ctaLine: Start learning the world's flags, free.
pricingNote: Free to play with no ads or subscription. An optional one-time $4.99 Pro purchase unlocks Hard Mode, Review Mistakes, Statistics and extra streak freezes.
